headline: Assurant Q2 Adj. EPS $6.41 Beats $5.18 Estimate, Sales $3.454B Beat $3.431B Estimate
summary: Assurant (NYSE:AIZ) reported quarterly earnings of $6.41 per share which beat the analyst consensus estimate of $5.18 by 23.75 percent. This is a 25.69 percent increase over earnings of $5.10 per share from the same
